# Sulfur

Type: Material | Internal ID: SulfurStone | Source: Lava Blob | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Sulfur is a material found in Ashlands.

## Availability

• Dropped by Lava Blobs.
• Sulfur nodes located under Sulfur arches in the Ashlands biome.

### Building

• Lava lantern

### Crafting

• Blob bomb Lava
• Brimstone
• Explosive payload
• Flametal mace
